description: FEMA flood zone screen (batch) — Screen up to 20 property locations against FEMA's National Flood Hazard Layer: flood zone (AE, VE, X...), subtype, Special Flood Hazard Area flag, base flood elevation, FIRM id, insurance requirement, and a portfolio rollup (percent in SFHA, HIGH/MODERATE/LOW). points = lat,lon pairs separated by ; (optional label=lat,lon). Screening only, not an official determination. For lending, insurance, real-estate and site-selection agents. Price: $0.03 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: realestate_flood_zone_batch
